安卓绑定后，应用在设备上加密保存登录凭据，并向服务端发送账号关联信息，以同步会员: After you link Android, the app encrypts sign-in credentials on the device and sends account association information to the server to synchronize membership and study access. Unlinking revokes this device’s sign-in authorization; it does not delete your learning account.
通过 Google Play 购买时，Google 处理付款；应用服务端使用购买: Google processes Google Play payments. The app does not receive your Google password or full payment card number.
使用 Gemini 免费服务时，Google 可使用提交内容和生成结果改进产品及: When unpaid Gemini services are used, Google may use submitted content and generated responses to improve its products and machine learning technologies, including human review. Do not submit sensitive, confidential or personal information.

安卓激励广告开放后，非会员可以自行选择观看。Google 广告 SDK 会处理: When Android rewarded ads are available, non-members can choose to watch them. The Google ads SDK processes IP addresses (which may indicate approximate location), ad interactions, diagnostics, and advertising or device identifiers for advertising, analytics and fraud prevention. Google also processes this data. Transmission is encrypted with TLS.
广告奖励核验使用随机奖励标识和交易信息，不将你的邮箱、造句或录音作为广告奖励参数: Reward verification uses random reward identifiers and transaction information. Your email, sentences and recordings are not sent as reward parameters. Where consent is required, the app offers choices through Google’s consent interface and provides a privacy options entry when required. Available ads depend on your choices and region.
安卓本地恢复页面读取支持格式的旧记录、待办、反思草稿和录音，用于查看、播放及由你: The Android local recovery page reads supported legacy records, tasks, reflection drafts and recordings for viewing, playback and export to a location you choose. It does not upload this data automatically. Your chosen file storage service may synchronize exported files according to its settings.
旧功过格网页入口打开原有独立服务；其账号、云端资料和订阅由原服务管理，并适用原服: The legacy Merit Ledger web entry opens the original separate service. That service manages its own accounts, cloud data and subscriptions under its own privacy notice.
